slot.brief: For a cubic, find the point of inflexion by setting f″(x) = 0 and verifying the sign change of f″.

stem: For $f(x)=2x^3-3x^2-12x+5$, the point of inflexion, where $f''$ changes sign, is

verdicts.working: f''(x)=12x-6, which changes sign at x=1/2. Then f(1/2)=-3/2.

working:
$f''(x)=12x-6=0\Rightarrow x=\dfrac12$; $f''$ changes from negative to positive there.
$f\left(\dfrac12\right)=-\dfrac32$.
